lines.text: It’s project time! Build a mini platformer: the hero walks and jumps with gravity, collects coins for points, avoids a hazard and reaches a goal.
Build a level: the hero walks and jumps with gravity, collects coins for points, avoids a hazard, and reaches a flag to win.
A coin checks if it is touching the hero.
When it is: change score, play a sound, and hide (or move somewhere new).
If the hero touches a hazard, send it back to the start (or lose a life).
If x position > 230, set x to 230 — walls at the edges stop the hero walking off.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
